'''Magravian cat-spice''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from the [[Magravia system/Legends|Magravia system]] that was purported to make a being's reflexes as sharp as [[chrysalide]] claws. This spice had been offered to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].
